svg.title: New user onboarding — complete sequence
svg.desc: Read top to bottom. Lifelines distinguish the user, setup assistant, ACED and its host worker, stage agents, existing tools and records, and independent monitoring and stopping. This is the integration qualification procedure; it does not certify a live cycle.
svg.text: PREVIEW · qualification required · arrows are interactions, not elapsed time
Read docs, source, tools, metrics and current state
Existing capabilities, native records and baseline
MAIN PATH: required capabilities exist. Missing capability -> record the gap; separate discussion before proceeding.
Bind identity, tool scopes, records, evidence storage and
Map -> product skills + runner configuration + native-record / safety connections. Secrets remain in existing
Reuse authorization already granted. It may include standing policy; a human is not required at every later handoff.
Verify independent protection and stop behavior
recover in a fresh session and
Native receipts, exact identities and permission results
IF CHECKS FAIL: repair configuration, skills or bindings and repeat affected checks. Readiness does not start an
4a Start a short real validation run
BEFORE EVERY TASK: persist intent, inputs, runner and budget; obtain host authorization; launch through the
configured runner. Before expanded scope, verify prior execution terminal / fenced. Wait or denial never grants
4b Run canary, then the separate main experiment
Positive allocation requires durable protection acknowledgment. Receipt / deadline binding cannot leave an
4c Decide and close the learning cycle
Promotion requires independent delayed-harm protection and separately authorized rollback before execution.
Already-settled no-effect decisions skip the extra invocation.
Completion can mean a valid inconclusive / revert result. Early stopping or allocation zero alone does not complete
Cases: worker / agent interruption; lost activation reply; interrupted deadline binding; brief and sustained
monitoring failures; authorized repair; second-goal exclusion.
UNKNOWN OUTCOME: retain uncertainty; observe or obtain fencing before replacement. Never blindly replay an
Persist stop intent and deliver the same idempotent stop
Stop delivery does not wait for agent cancellation. Acknowledgment is not confirmed zero. Agent interruption alone
FAILED VALIDATION: fix authorized integration issues or report the responsible owner's blocker; repeat affected
cases. Every manual state repair is a failed autonomy criterion.
Finish only with test effects settled, no competing owner and evidence retained. Passing these checks does not
Start an authorized goal through the
persist next run for host worker
The setup assistant can exit. ACED owns orchestration; stage agents use existing tools; monitoring / stopping
Development preview · typed Python setup · live qualification required
